name: stratos-web
description: Stratos Media — static trilingual public site plus the private React portal.

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix portal && npm ci --prefix experiments
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build:site && npm run build:home && npm run build:portal && npm run strip:comments && npm run fingerprint && npm run fonts:check
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix portal run typecheck && npm --prefix experiments run typecheck
scripts.test:full: npm run build:full && npm run build:home && playwright test --config playwright.full.config.ts
scripts.validate:full: npm run clean:validate && npm run build && npm run test:full

comments.dependencies: Runtime dependencies of the NETLIFY FUNCTIONS, and nothing else. The public site ships no third-party JavaScript and the portal has its own manifest; this block exists because Netlify bundles netlify/functions/* against the ROOT package.json, not against portal/. Omitting @supabase/supabase-js here is what made every lead submission crash with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at the store step — the SDK was installed under portal/node_modules, where the function cannot reach it.
